title: Fixed50 + wave2 factor-graph expansion audit
purpose: Test whether adding the 14 wave2 verified audio strings creates a new low-risk operation or a new same-title family beyond the already identified travel A-only lane.

method.enumeration: Enumerate paths whose four adjacent factor edges are attested in at least one fixed50 or wave2-verified source.
method.exclude: Exact historical source paths are excluded from novel candidates.
method.distance_audit: For each novel path involving wave2 provenance, compute minimum A/B/C/D/E Hamming distance from all 64 research sources.

key_findings.finding: Even after adding all 14 wave2 verified audio strings, every minimum-distance-1 novel path is still either A-only or E-only.
key_findings.implication: Wave2 does not provide empirical support for enabling B-only, C-only, or D-only operations.

key_findings.finding: At title-level scene resolution, the only new same-title minimum-distance-1 pair is the two directed A-only swaps between travel poems 90 and 93.
candidate_keys: ともかくも|まは|るなりいま|みか|きよき
やとちかく|まは|るなかたひ|きよ|くゆく
key_findings.implication: v1.07's selection of wave2-travel-maha remains the unique narrow-scene priority produced by the combined graph.

key_findings.finding: The only distance-2 patterns are A+E, D+E, and B+C; no evidence establishes a new safe same-scene operation from these paths.
key_findings.implication: Do not expand the generator contract to block swaps merely because graph paths exist.

bottleneck_update.previous: Could a missing low-risk operation reveal a third family?
bottleneck_update.current: No evidence for a missing low-risk operation in fixed50 or fixed50+wave2 verified graph.
required_to_advance: direct target-poem evidence that resolves musu or travel holds
or newly verified historical poems that create a genuinely new narrow-scene factor lane

next_action: Shift active research from operation invention to historically verified corpus expansion/source confirmation.
